title: Slovakian Braised Greens
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian-inspired dish made with kissed greens and braised in a flavorful broth.
instructions: Heat the braised broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add sliced Slovakian sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Add bay leaves, tomato paste, and red wine. Stir to combine.
Add kissed greens to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the greens are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream if desired.
